description_en: Creates text-to-speech tasks, voice notification tasks, and voice verification code tasks for multiple called numbers using a service instance
description_zh: 使用服务实例给多个被叫号码创建文本转语音任务、语音通知任务和语音验证码任务
kebab_example: aliyun dyvmsapi create-call-task --task-name '语音通知' --biz-type VMS_VOICE_CODE --template-code TTS_21220000 --template-name '语音通知模板' --resource-type LIST --resource 055162140000 --data-type JSON --data 'paramNames_:_name_,,_key_,_calleeList_:_callee_:_13100000000_,_params_:_张三_,_淘宝订单_,_callee_:_13200000000_,_params_:_李四_,_天猫订单' --fire-time 1 --stop-time 1 --schedule-type 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateCallTask

parameters.help_en: The name of the call task
parameters.name: task_name

parameters.help_en:
The templatetype of the voice template. Valid values:

VMS_VOICE_TTS: text-to-speech template for voice notifications.

VMS_VOICE_CODE: voice file template for voice notifications.

VMS_TTS: voice authenticate code template
parameters.help_zh:
语音模板类型。取值：

VMS_VOICE_TTS：语音通知文本转语音模板。

VMS_VOICE_CODE：语音通知文件模板。

VMS_TTS：语音验证码模板
parameters.name: biz_type

parameters.help_en:
The template code. Valid values:

For a text-to-speech template for voice notifications, obtain the Template ID on the Text-to-Speech Template page in the Voice Messaging Service console (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/call/notify/list/textToVoice).

For a voice file template for voice notifications, obtain the Voice ID on the Voice Notification File page in the Voice Messaging Service console (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/call/notify/list/voiceFiles).

For a voice verification code template, obtain the Template ID on the Voice Verification Code page in the Voice Messaging Service console (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/call/code/list)
parameters.help_zh:
模板Code。取值：

如果是语音通知文本转语音模板，可以在语音服务控制台 (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/call/notify/list/textToVoice)文本转语音模板页面获取模板ID。

如果是语音通知文件模板，可以在语音服务控制台 (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/call/notify/list/voiceFiles)语音通知文件页面获取语音ID。

如果是语音验证码模板，可以在语音服务控制台 (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/call/code/list)语音验证码页面获取模板ID
parameters.name: template_code

parameters.help_en:
The template name. Valid values:
For a text-to-speech template for voice notifications, obtain the Template Name on the Text-to-Speech Template page in the Voice Messaging Service console (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/call/notify/list/textToVoice).

For a voice file template for voice notifications, obtain the Voice File Name on the Voice Notification File page in the Voice Messaging Service console (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/call/notify/list/voiceFiles).

For a voice verification code template, obtain the Template Name on the Voice Verification Code page in the Voice Messaging Service console (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/call/code/list)
parameters.help_zh:
模板名称。取值：
如果是语音通知文本转语音模板，可以在语音服务控制台 (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/call/notify/list/textToVoice)文本转语音模板页面获取模板名称。

如果是语音通知文件模板，可以在语音服务控制台 (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/call/notify/list/voiceFiles)语音通知文件页面获取语音文件名。

如果是语音验证码模板，可以在语音服务控制台 (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/call/code/list)语音验证码页面获取模板名称
parameters.name: template_name

parameters.help_en: The type of the calling number. Fixed value: LIST
parameters.help_zh: 主叫号码类型。固定取值：LIST
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
The calling number. Specify the service instance ID. Only service instances with bound real numbers are supported. Call tasks cannot be initiated if no real number is bound to the service instance.

You can obtain the service instance ID or bind a real number on the Service Instance Management page in the Voice Messaging Service console (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/virtual/list)
parameters.help_zh:
主叫号码，请传入服务实例ID。目前仅支持已绑定真实号的服务实例，服务实例下未绑定真实号码无法发起通话任务。

您可以在语音服务控制台 (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/virtual/list)服务实例管理页面获取服务实例ID或绑定真实号码
parameters.name: resource

parameters.help_en:
The type of the called number. Valid values:

LIST: the LIST format, which is used for text-to-speech templates or voice files without variables.
JSON: the JSON format, which is used for text-to-speech templates that contain variable parameters
parameters.help_zh:
被叫号码类型。取值：

LIST：LIST格式用于无变量的文本转语音模板或语音文件。
JSON：JSON格式用于内含变量参数的文本转语音模板
parameters.name: data_type

parameters.example: { "paramNames":["name",,"key"], "calleeList":[ { "callee":"1310000****", "params":["张三","淘宝订单"] }, { "callee":"1320000****", "params":["李四","天猫订单"] } ] }
parameters.help_en:
The called numbers or called data that contains variable parameter values.

If DataType is set to LIST, specify called numbers separated by commas (,). Example: `187*****123,021****1234,177*****123`.
If DataType is set to JSON, specify the called numbers and variable parameters in the format shown in the example value. In the example, `paramNames` corresponds to the variable names in the text-to-speech template, and `calleelist` is the called data (`callee` corresponds to the called number, and `params` corresponds to the actual values of the template variables).

For a landline number such as `021-12345678`, specify `02112345678`
parameters.help_zh:
被叫号码或包含变量参数值的被叫数据。

当DataType取值为LIST时，传入用英文半角逗号`,`分隔的被叫号码。填写格式示例`187*****123,021****1234,177*****123`。
当DataType取值为JSON时，被叫号码及变量传参填写格式请参考示例值。示例值中`paramNames`对应文本转语音模板内的变量名，`calleelist`为被叫数据（`callee`对应被叫号码，`params`对应模板变量实际传值）。

被叫号码为固话号码如`021-12345678`，应传入`02112345678`
parameters.name: data

Code.description_en:
The request status code.
OK indicates that the request was successful.
For other error codes, see [API error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/112502.html）
Code.description_zh:
请求状态码。
返回OK代表请求成功。
其他错误码，请参见[API错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/112502.html）

Data.description_en: The task ID. Use this task ID to execute the call task by calling the ExecuteCallTask (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/vms/developer-reference/api-dyvmsapi-2017-05-25-executecalltask) operation
Data.description_zh: 任务ID。使用此任务ID，通过ExecuteCallTask (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/vms/developer-reference/api-dyvmsapi-2017-05-25-executecalltask?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.2fb55105AJKYdF)接口执行通话任务
